passive.name: Void Shift
passive.description: When he hasn't recently taken damage or been crowd controlled, Malzahar gains massive damage reduction and crowd control immunity, lingering for a short period after taking damage.

primaryAbilities.name: Call of the Void
primaryAbilities.description: Malzahar opens up two portals to the Void. After a short delay, they fire projectiles that deal Magic Damage and silence enemy champions.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Malzahar opens two portals to the Void that fire projectiles inward, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamagetooltip }} magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Silencing</status> for {{ silenceduration }} second(s).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Void Swarm
primaryAbilities.description: Malzahar summons Voidlings to attack nearby enemies.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Passive: Malzahar's other Abilities give him a stack when cast (max {{ stackcap }}).

Active: Malzahar summons a Voidling plus an additional Voidling per stack. Voidlings last {{ voidlingduration }} seconds and deal {{ voidlingbonusdamagetooltip }} magic damage each hit.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Malefic Visions
primaryAbilities.description:
Malzahar infects his target's mind with cruel visions of their demise, dealing damage over time. Using Malzahar's other spells on the target will refresh the visions.

If the target dies while afflicted by the visions, they pass on to a nearby enemy unit and Malzahar gains Mana. Malzahar's Voidlings are attracted to affected units.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Malzahar inflicts terrible visions, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage over {{ duration }} seconds. Applying Call of the Void or Nether Grasp to the victim during this time refreshes the visions.

If the victim dies, Malzahar gains {{ manarestore }} Mana and the visions spread to the nearest enemy.

Malefic Visions executes minions below {{ minionexecutethreshold }} Health.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Nether Grasp
primaryAbilities.description: Malzahar channels the essence of the Void to suppress an enemy champion over a zone of damaging negative energy.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Malzahar <status>Suppresses</status> an enemy champion and deals <magicDamage>{{ totaldamagetooltip }} magic damage</magicDamage> over {{ ccduration }} seconds. A zone of negative energy is created around his target dealing <magicDamage>{{ zonedamagetooltip }} max Health magic damage</magicDamage> over {{ poolduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}
